purpose: The integrator half of card CT-COMPOSED-NATIVE coupled edit: the composed-epoch route gains a runner that really compiles and runs an admitted case own emitted C, so CT22 and CT25 three emission/native rows move from unassessed to executed. Published as a superseding record per constraint 21 - the ct22-wire and ct-wire-lane-3 records keep their bytes. CT23 is deliberately absent: it is the route refusal and never reaches the backend.
derivation_rule: A stage is executed only where a named workspace test runs it on the case own artifact. run_composed_native does so on every cargo test of this workspace; each of its arms was falsified before being believed (corrupt the pinned transcript, suffix the byte expectation, append a leaking constructor). A native run is an observation, never a proof.
